findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizing bleach to be available during inspection. Discussed with PIC, sanitizer was purchased from a nearby Dollar General. Sanitizer solution was remade and tested at 100 ppm CL.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(B) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (B) Except for those that are generated on-site at the time of use, chemical SANITIZERS that are used to sanitize EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-7, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed no handwashing to be set up upon arrival, Discussed with PIC, hand washing was being done at church nearby. A temporary hand washing station was prepared. Ensure hand washing is available on site.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-201.11: (A) The PERMIT HOLDER shall require FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES to report to the PERSON IN CHARGE information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD. Report: Symptoms (all P except lesion), diagnosis (all P), and possible exposures (P).  (E) Responsibility of food employee to report symptoms/disease to PIC. 

(REPEAT) Observed no signed employee health reporting agreements. CFPM and PIC, Rev. Melissa, should review and sign the document. Discussed with PIC. Provided copy for facility. Inspector will follow-up on 10/25/21. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 2/10/21.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.citation_text:
2-102.11(C)(2) (Pf) PIC does not demonstrate the responsibility of preventing the transmission of foodborne disease by employees that may cause food borne disease. Discussed related section of the food code.  Reference 2-102.11(C)(2).

Observed facility to lack signed employee health reporting agreements. Provided new paperwork and highlighted importance of document. Inspector will follow-up on 2/20/20.

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events
findings.citation_text:
2-501.11  (Pf) Establishment does not have procedures for employees to follow when responding to discharging of vomitus or fecal matter. Provide procedures to comply with this section of the code. Reference 2-501.11.

Observed facility to lack a policy for Norovirus illness clean-up. Provided paperwork for facility. COS.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the microwave to be soiled. Clean the non-food contact surfaces as needed.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the can opener blade soiled. Clean the can opener blade.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed a small leak at the three compartment sink. Repair the leak.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: The water spout of the coffee pot above the filter basket is soiled. 750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use and any time they may have become contaminated.  Clean and maintain clean.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: The filters on the hood vents have some dist accumulation. 750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the attacjhed equipment and maintain free of accumulated soil.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: Cardboard boxes are being used to store pots and lids under the hot holding area in the kitchen. 750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition. Cardboard is not considered a clean or washable surface. Replace with washable containers for proper storage.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: The can opener bolted to the side of the counter has a blade that is soiled. 750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use and any time it may have become contaminated.  Properly wash, rinse and sanitize the  can opener.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.citation_text:
750.1310 - Can of black oven paint was observed in a cabinet with cooking spray, coffee creamer, and clean dishes. Paint was moved to a location away from food and clean dishes.
All toxic items must be properly stored separate from food and all food related items (i.e. clean dishes, single service articles, etc.) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.
